name: response_ir_chat_stream_usage_responses
_comment: Same upstream usage script toward Responses SSE: full inclusive prompt 12 is kept and the cached share is detailed (cached 4), output 7, total 19. Terminal response.completed repeats the authoritative totals; sequence_numbers pin the lifecycle.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
